dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge boundary with a distinct geometric discontinuity/jagged indentation on the lower posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification, transitioning smoothly from the leading edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 42-degree incline relative to the longitudinal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base-to-height ratio of approximately 1.35:1 based on visible pixel extent.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch or irregular excision on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; diffuse light-colored epidermal mottling on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Fully visible caudal fluke positioned vertically, characterized by pointed tips (flukes) and a deep, well-defined median notch.
